quizzes.stem: A team keeps pasting the same release checklist into the chat. Which feature does the documentation's trigger table name?

options.a: A line in the persistent project file, loaded in every session
options.b: A hook that fires on every edit
options.c: An output style that sets the tone of each reply

explanation.d: The trigger table says "You paste the same playbook into chat for the third time" calls for a skill.
explanation.a: Ruled out because that file is "Persistent context loaded every conversation", not a procedure kept for the moment it is needed.
explanation.b: Ruled out because a hook fits "automation that must run on every matching event", not a procedure to read and follow.
explanation.c: Ruled out because an output style is for "a voice, length or format wanted in every response".

quizzes.stem: A repository's CLAUDE.md has grown to 600 lines of endpoint documentation. What does the page advise?

options.a: Move the detail into skills, which load only when needed
options.b: Keep it where it is, because the file is read once per session
options.c: Turn the whole file into one subagent definition
options.d: Replace it with a hook that prints the reference on every request

explanation.a: The page says "Keep CLAUDE.md under 200 lines." and that reference material goes to skills, "which load on demand".
explanation.b: Ruled out because "CLAUDE.md is paid for on every request", not once per session.
explanation.c: Ruled out because a subagent is for "context isolation, parallel tasks, specialized workers", not for reference text.
explanation.d: Ruled out because a hook "costs nothing in context unless its output is added as messages", and one that prints the reference would add it to every event.

quizzes.stem: Which feature costs no context unless its output is added to the conversation?

options.a: A skill whose description is loaded at the start of each session
options.b: An output style that applies to the whole session

explanation.c: The table says a hook loads "nothing, since they run externally" and costs "zero, unless the hook returns context".
explanation.a: Ruled out because for a skill the "descriptions are in every request".
explanation.b: Ruled out because an output style loads "the active style's full instructions" with a cost on "every request".
explanation.d: Ruled out because "CLAUDE.md is paid for on every request", with its full content loaded at session start.

quizzes.stem: A team must make sure that Claude never touches a file named `.env`. Which feature gives the guarantee?

options.a: A line in CLAUDE.md that forbids the edit
options.b: A `PreToolUse` hook that blocks the edit
options.c: A skill that explains why the file is private
options.d: An output style that tells Claude to refuse

explanation.b: The page says "A `PreToolUse` hook that blocks the edit is enforcement."
explanation.a: Ruled out because such an instruction "is a request, not a guarantee".
explanation.c: Ruled out because with a skill, "Claude interprets the instructions; outcome can vary."
explanation.d: Ruled out because "Claude follows both as instructions, so neither is enforced."

quizzes.stem: A research task reads dozens of files and only the conclusions matter to the main conversation. Which feature fits?

options.a: A line in CLAUDE.md, which is loaded in full at the launch of each session
options.b: A skill, which adds everything that it reads to the main window as well
options.c: A hook, which runs a script once per session when the work starts
options.d: A subagent, which returns only a summary

explanation.d: The page says to use a subagent "when you need context isolation or when your context window is getting full".
explanation.b: Ruled out because a skill "adds to your main window".
explanation.c: Ruled out because a hook is for "when the action must happen the same way every time and doesn't need Claude to think".
explanation.a: Ruled out because the page says "Put it in CLAUDE.md if Claude should always know it", and conclusions of one task are not such a rule.

quizzes.stem: A team connects Claude to its database and wants the model to use the tables and queries well. What does the page suggest?

options.a: Only an MCP server, since it provides everything that the work needs
options.b: MCP for access, and a skill for the schema and patterns
options.c: Only a skill, since a skill can run the queries itself
options.d: A plugin, because plugins replace both of them

explanation.b: The page says "These solve different problems and work well together", with MCP for the connection and a skill that "can hold the team's database schema and query patterns".
explanation.a: Ruled out because MCP provides "Tools and data access", not knowledge of the schema and patterns.
explanation.c: Ruled out because a skill provides "Knowledge, workflows, reference material", and the connection to the external system comes from MCP.
explanation.d: Ruled out because "Each extension solves a different problem", and a plugin only packages them.

quizzes.stem: A team wants a linter to run after every file edit, with no reliance on Claude remembering. Which feature fits, and why?

options.a: A skill, because Claude reads it before each change
options.b: A hook, because it fires on its event and the trigger is guaranteed
options.c: A line in the project file, because it is read at the start of a session
options.d: An output style, because it applies to the whole session

explanation.b: The page says a hook "Always fires on its event; the trigger is guaranteed".
explanation.a: Ruled out because with a skill, "Claude interprets the instructions; outcome can vary."
explanation.c: Ruled out because an instruction in the project file "is a request, not a guarantee".
explanation.d: Ruled out because "Claude follows both as instructions, so neither is enforced."

quizzes.stem: A team uses the same set of skills, hooks and MCP servers in six repositories. What does the documentation suggest?

options.a: Package them as a plugin, shared through a marketplace
options.b: Copy the files into each repository by hand and keep them in step
options.c: Put the whole set into one long CLAUDE.md in each repository
options.d: Convert every item into a subagent that is spawned for each task

explanation.a: The page says "A plugin bundles skills, hooks, subagents, and MCP servers into a single installable unit", for "the same setup in several repositories, or to share it".
explanation.b: Ruled out because the trigger is "A second repository needs the same setup", which calls for a plugin.
explanation.c: Ruled out because CLAUDE.md is paid for on "every request", and the guidance is "Keep CLAUDE.md under 200 lines."
explanation.d: Ruled out because a subagent is "an isolated worker with its own context", not a packaging unit.

quizzes.stem: A workflow that deploys to production must never start unless a person types its name. Which setting does the page give?

options.a: `disable-model-invocation: true`, which hides it until invoked
options.b: A longer description, which makes Claude hesitate before it considers using it
options.c: A line in CLAUDE.md that asks Claude to wait for a person to approve the run
options.d: An output style that makes every reply shorter and more formal for the user

explanation.a: The page says to use `disable-model-invocation: true`: "This saves context and ensures only you trigger them."
explanation.b: Ruled out because "If descriptions are vague or overlap, Claude may load the wrong skill or miss one that would help", which is no control.
explanation.c: Ruled out because a line in CLAUDE.md "is a request, not a guarantee".
explanation.d: Ruled out because an output style sets "a voice, length or format wanted in every response", and says nothing about starting skills.

quizzes.stem: A project has an API style guide of 3,000 lines that matters only when endpoints are written. Where does it belong?

options.a: In CLAUDE.md, so that it is available in every session
options.b: In an output style, so that it shapes each response
options.c: In a skill, which loads the full content only when used
options.d: In an MCP server, so that Claude can open it as a connection

explanation.c: The page says reference material goes to skills, "which load on demand", while "descriptions at start, full content when used" keeps the cost low.
explanation.a: Ruled out because "CLAUDE.md is paid for on every request", and "Keep CLAUDE.md under 200 lines."
explanation.b: Ruled out because an output style is "a voice, length or format wanted in every response", not a library of facts.
explanation.d: Ruled out because MCP "connects Claude to external services", and a local guide is knowledge, not a service: "MCP for knowledge."
